verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA at the very top, beside the logo and ahead of the headline, so the page reads backwards. The logo is shoved right, off the left text axis, and the can sits off-centre from its backing circle. B keeps the original reading order: logo, can, headline, copy, then CTA. But the can is still offset from the circle, the body copy and the 'Now in 4-packs' line are jammed against each other, and the logo is tiny.
